meta.title: PRTS Omni Bridge
meta.description: Expose this Harness's sessions, agents and tools to the PRTS Omni Android client over a token-guarded local HTTP + WebSocket bridge.

log.ready: prts-omni-bridge: listening on {endpoint} (LAN {lan}); pairing token is ready — enter it in PRTS Omni.
log.lanDenied: prts-omni-bridge: bindHost "{host}" needs allowLan=true; the bridge stays disabled.

errors.loopbackOnly: this endpoint only accepts loopback requests
errors.bodyTooLarge: request body exceeds the 64 KiB limit
errors.badJson: request body is not a JSON object
errors.sessionNotFound: session "{id}" was not found in this Host process
errors.missingAgent: no live Agent is available to authorize this action
errors.noAgents: no live Agent is registered in this Host process
errors.wsBadToken: websocket upgrade rejected: missing or invalid pairing token
errors.wsBacklog: websocket closed: unacknowledged backlog exceeded 1000 messages
errors.wsTooLarge: websocket closed: frame exceeds the size limit
